body:
### Describe the issue

As far as I can tell, Proton will copy out the shared memory buffer to global memory 4 bytes at a time on a single thread: https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/blob/c186592a17299439900d712e85556e8578345821/third_party/proton/Dialect/lib/ProtonGPUToLLVM/PatternProtonGPUOpToLLVM.cpp#L271-L272 This seems quite inefficient. Is it reasonable to vectorize these stores and have all threads participate to speed it up? On my basic matrix multiplication kernel it's over 40% of the overhead with the kernel doing nothing.

### Environment details

Triton: main
GPU: GH200
title: Proton buffer copyout is slower than it needs to be
